name: Algaz Station
summary: At Algaz Station, Mountaineers keep watch over the northern road from Loch Modan to the Wetlands. South of Dun Algaz, the outpost guards the mountain pass.

sections.title: Watching the Northern Pass
sections.body: Dwarven Mountaineers watch the road north from Loch Modan at Algaz Station. East of North Gate Pass and south of Dun Algaz, the post guards the route between Ironforge and the northern lowlands. Trade and troops travel through the mountain tunnels, though beasts and troggs threaten the hills. The Mountaineers keep the way open and give weary travelers a place to rest, make repairs, and find martial support before entering the pass.

faq.answer: Algaz Station is an Ironforge military outpost in northwestern Loch Modan. Its Mountaineers guard the passes leading north to Dun Algaz and aid travelers on the way.

faq.q: Where does the station get its name?
aliases: why is it called algaz station
faq.answer: The station takes its name from Dun Algaz, the great dwarven pass and tunnel system just to its north. Dun Algaz connects Loch Modan to the Wetlands.

faq.q: Who can be found at Algaz Station?
faq.answer: Dwarven Mountaineers man the outpost, including Mountaineer Stormpike. Armorer Gothor Brumn repairs travelers' gear.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Algaz Station marks Ironforge's reach. Its Mountaineers guard the king's highways against dangers from the mountains.
As an Alliance traveler, you can use the outpost as a secure staging ground and repair stop on the way between Loch Modan and the northern marshlands.
